why: Printed size of every figure text element; venues may bound it (IEEE: 8-10 pt).
Figure font; computer-modern matches a default LaTeX body.
Whether figures are drawn at printed size and included without width=.
Colour palette (common/figure/palettes.tsv); okabe-ito is colour-blind safe.
Linear axes unless a log axis is unavoidable, or free choice.
Fraction of the data range left above the tallest data.
Where (a), (b), (c) sit: bottom-left on the x-label baseline outside the frame for data plots, inside the bottom-left corner for drawings; or top-left inside.
Corner of per-panel labels in stacked panels, wrapped onto two lines.
Width of each of two paired panels as a fraction of the text width.

Bracket style for units in axis labels: brackets "Loss [W]" or parentheses "Loss (W)". The author owns the choice; the IEEE author guide shows parentheses (venue note in knowledge/venues/ieee/README.md).
Where characteristic frequencies or orders are marked on a data figure: on a secondary top axis with guide lines behind the data, inside the plot area, or not at all.
